simple.meaning: אַרְאֵלִי (ʼArʼêlîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “Areli (or an Arelite, collectively), an Israelite and his descendants.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אַרְאֵלִי (H692) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 46:16, with occurrences in Genesis, Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַרְאֵלִי (H692) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אַרְאֵלִי (H692) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אַרְאֵלִי (ʼArʼêlîy) / H692 is traced through Genesis 46:16, Numbers 26:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
